scope: Only this theorem and the same six Lean declarations; one corrected check.

payload.claim: Kernel-checked effective OOE counting and witness theorem; independent mathematical review remains pending. For all natural M,T>=1, let A_M(T) count 0<=t<T with s=1+2Mt>=16, floor(s^(9/2)) even, and floor(s^(9/4))=1 modulo 2M. Then abs(A_M(T)-T/(4M)) <= [5+128*M^(1/4)*(3+log(T)/16)^2]*T^(63/64)+8 <= 2^14*M^(1/4)*T^(127/128), with natural logarithm. At T=2^2176*M^160 the count is at least T/(8M)>0. Some t<T gives an actual OOE Juggler return with n=s^2<2^4354*M^322, all prefix states at least n, exit strictly greater than n, and both endpoints 1 modulo 2M. The predicate equivalence includes both half-open endpoints and M=1. The Lean proof includes the signed derivative estimates, all cutoff Fourier modes, finite Fejer box discrepancy, dyadic initial segment, cutoff rounding, threshold exclusions, logarithm absorption, and witness extraction; none is assumed as an analytic premise. It uses independently proved third/fifth derivative tests, not a formalization of the exact external Arias de Reyna formula used by the alternative written proof. This is one fixed word; the constants are impractical and the OOE word-code denominator is 1. No effective arbitrary-word, cycle, termination, or infinite-continuation claim is made. Included in Paper E version 0.7.1 and its selected Lean audit.

declarations.name: return_parameter_iff
declarations.docstring: The existing parameter predicate is exactly the integer-floor count in the theorem.
declarations.statement: theorem return_parameter_iff {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (t : ℕ) : ReturnParameter 2 1 M t ↔ 16 ≤ 1+2*M*t ∧ ⌊((1+2*M*t : ℕ) : ℝ)^(9/2 : ℝ)⌋₊ % 2 = 0 ∧ ⌊((1+2*M*t : ℕ) : ℝ)^(9/4 : ℝ)⌋₊ % (2*M) = 1

declarations.name: count_error
declarations.docstring: The first explicit error bound for the exact thresholded parameter count.
declarations.statement: theorem count_error {M T : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hT : 1 ≤ T) : |(count (ReturnParameter 2 1 M) T : ℝ) - T/(4*M)| ≤ (5+128*(M : ℝ)^(1/4 : ℝ)*(3+Real.log T/16)^2)*(T : ℝ)^(63/64 : ℝ)+8

declarations.name: error_power_bound
declarations.docstring: The displayed first error is bounded by the simpler power error.

declarations.name: witnessCutoff
declarations.docstring: The explicit finite search length, uniform in the modulus.

declarations.name: count_at_witnessCutoff
declarations.docstring: At the explicit cutoff the actual return count is at least T/(8M), hence positive.
declarations.statement: theorem count_at_witnessCutoff {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) : (witnessCutoff M : ℝ)/(8*M) ≤ count (ReturnParameter 2 1 M) (witnessCutoff M) ∧ 0 < count (ReturnParameter 2 1 M) (witnessCutoff M)

declarations.name: exists_bounded_modular_return
declarations.docstring: Q5: a quantitatively bounded actual OOE modular return for every positive modulus.
declarations.statement: theorem exists_bounded_modular_return {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) : ∃ t < 2^2176*M^160, ReturnParameter 2 1 M t ∧ (1+2*M*t)^2 < 2^4354*M^322 ∧ ModularReturn 2 1 M ((1+2*M*t)^2)

payload.claim: For every natural M>=1, define A_M(T) to be the number of natural t<T such that s=1+2*M*t>=16, floor(s^(9/2)) is even, and floor(s^(9/4)) modulo (2*M) is 1. For every natural T>=1, abs(A_M(T)-T/(4*M)) <= [5+128*M^(1/4)*(3+log(T)/16)^2]*T^(63/64)+8 <= 2^14*M^(1/4)*T^(127/128). Powers with fractional exponents are real powers, floors are natural floors, and log is the natural logarithm. For T0=2^2176*M^160, A_M(T0)>=T0/(8*M)>0. There exists a natural t<T0 with s=1+2*M*t>=16 and n=s^2<2^4354*M^322 whose actual Juggler source parities at times 0,1,2 are odd,odd,even; n<=J^[j](n) for every natural j<=3; n<J^[3](n); and n modulo (2*M) and J^[3](n) modulo (2*M) both equal 1. Here J(n)=Nat.sqrt(n) for even n and Nat.sqrt(n^3) for odd n, Nat.sqrt is the integer square root, and J^[j] denotes j-fold iteration.

declarations.name: return_parameter_iff
declarations.docstring: The existing parameter predicate is exactly the integer-floor count in the theorem.
declarations.statement: theorem return_parameter_iff {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (t : ℕ) : ReturnParameter 2 1 M t ↔ 16 ≤ 1+2*M*t ∧ ⌊((1+2*M*t : ℕ) : ℝ)^(9/2 : ℝ)⌋₊ % 2 = 0 ∧ ⌊((1+2*M*t : ℕ) : ℝ)^(9/4 : ℝ)⌋₊ % (2*M) = 1

declarations.name: count_error
declarations.docstring: The first error bound for the exact thresholded parameter count. Here `count P T = ((Finset.range T).filter P).card`, counting natural indices `0 <= t < T`. The preceding `return_parameter_iff` expands the predicate `ReturnParameter 2 1 M t` into the three explicit floor and threshold guards. All displayed fractional powers are real powers and `Real.log` is the natural logarithm.
declarations.statement: theorem count_error {M T : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hT : 1 ≤ T) : |(count (ReturnParameter 2 1 M) T : ℝ) - T/(4*M)| ≤ (5+128*(M : ℝ)^(1/4 : ℝ)*(3+Real.log T/16)^2)*(T : ℝ)^(63/64 : ℝ)+8

declarations.name: error_power_bound
declarations.docstring: The displayed first error is bounded by the simpler power error.

declarations.name: witnessCutoff
declarations.docstring: The explicit finite search length is `witnessCutoff M = 2^2176*M^160`. This is the definition's value, uniform in the positive natural modulus M.

declarations.name: count_at_witnessCutoff
declarations.docstring: At the explicit cutoff the actual return count is at least T/(8M), hence positive.
declarations.statement: theorem count_at_witnessCutoff {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) : (witnessCutoff M : ℝ)/(8*M) ≤ count (ReturnParameter 2 1 M) (witnessCutoff M) ∧ 0 < count (ReturnParameter 2 1 M) (witnessCutoff M)

declarations.name: exists_bounded_modular_return
declarations.docstring: Here `ModularReturn 2 1 M n` means `n % 2 = 1` and `itinerary n 3 = [Branch.odd, Branch.odd, Branch.even]`, `(forall j <= 3, n <= floorPower^[j] n)`, `n < floorPower^[3] n`, and `n % (2*M) = 1` and `floorPower^[3] n % (2*M) = 1`. The Juggler map is `floorPower n = if n % 2 = 0 then Nat.sqrt n else Nat.sqrt (n^3)`. `itinerary n 3` lists the source parities of n and its first two iterates; `floorPower^[j]` denotes j-fold iteration. Thus this is an actual OOE orbit.
declarations.statement: theorem exists_bounded_modular_return {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) : ∃ t < 2^2176*M^160, ReturnParameter 2 1 M t ∧ (1+2*M*t)^2 < 2^4354*M^322 ∧ ModularReturn 2 1 M ((1+2*M*t)^2)
